question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution: The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'believes.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options: Word Meaning accepts to receive something willingly, to approve or agree to something, or to believe that something is true or valid. (स्वेच्छा से कुछ प्राप्त करना, किसी बात को स्वीकार करना या सहमत होना, या यह विश्वास करना कि कुछ सत्य या मान्य है) credits to acknowledge or give recognition to someone or something for their contributions, achievements or actions; a unit of value in a financial or educational context. (उनके योगदान, उपलब्धियों या कार्यों के लिए किसी को या कुछ को स्वीकार करने या मान्यता देने के लिए; वित्तीय या शैक्षिक संदर्भ में मूल्य की एक इकाई) trusts to have confidence in someone or something, to rely on or believe in their abilities or intentions, or to entrust them with responsibility or information. (किसी पर या किसी चीज पर विश्वास करना, उनकी क्षमताओं या इरादों पर भरोसा करना या विश्वास करना, या उन्हें जिम्मेदारी सौंपना) believes to have confidence in the truth or existence of something, to accept as true or real, or to hold a particular opinion or conviction. (किसी चीज की सच्चाई या अस्तित्व में विश्वास रखना, सत्य या वास्तविक के रूप में स्वीकार करना या किसी विशेष राय या दृढ़ विश्वास को धारण करना) • Let's look at the sentence: "The research ____________ that animal fat is good for human body and helps in reducing the risks of heart attack." • We can say that the implied meaning of the sentence is that the research **put forward the opinion** that animal fat is healthy for humans and lowers the risk of heart attacks. • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "believes" to make the sentence meaningfully correct. • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1. ​ Complete passage:__ A new world research shows that the French (1) consume large amounts of cheese and butter. Therefore, they have low levels of heart disease. The research (2) believes that animal fat is good for human body and helps in reducing the risks of heart attack. This study was (3) conducted in 2018 in 21 low and middle income countries. However, it (4) concluded that eating moderately is the (5) crucial key in this regard. 45:T2851, The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'conducted.'
